messages:
Alex P.: Atlas just pinged — 60 H100s push back to 2026-04-20 for eu-west. They offered a split-ship: 25 this week, 35 later. Wants an amended PO. Also proposing depot-first 'repair-then-replace' flow for DOAs. Thoughts? @Maya R. @Carter (ops)

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Confirmed new ETA full: 2026-04-20. We can execute split: ship 25 (AMS depot) immediately, remaining 35 on the follow-up. DOA options: 1) immediate replacement air (premium), 2) conditional depot repair with replacement only if repair fails. Commercials: 2.5% credit on tranche delay OR 1.25% per-unit rebate if you accept conditional depot repair. Depot locations: AMS or BCN. Can lock AMS for you.

Carter (ops): We prefer the 25 early to feed canaries in eu-west. Critical: units must be provisioned with our fleet image and FW v1.4.0. If Atlas cannot flash, they must perform a verified reflash + smoke before we mark as accepted. Depot repairs must include a physical photo manifest and hash of the flashed image. Which depot will handle repairs if we lock AMS?

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: If AMS locked, depot repairs and reflash will be done in NL (AMS hub). We can add reflash+smoketest step and provide per-unit evidence (photo, sha256 of image, smoke log). Conditional repair SLA: repair attempt within 7 business days; if repair fails, we air-ship replacement within 36h. We will absorb depot labor but not expedite freight unless replacement path triggered. CSV manifest 24h prior to ship includes serial, pre_ship_fw, depot_id. Sample amendment snippet: 

```
PO: RW-2026-1387-A
Line: H100-80GB x60
Amendment: Ship 25 now (AMS), balance 35 on hold
Rebates: delay_credit=2.5% | conditional_repair_rebate=1.25%/unit
```

Maya R.: Conditional repair acceptable only if: 1) Atlas performs our reflash checklist, 2) post-flash perf spot-check (our 3 quick benchmarks), 3) unit-level rollback guarantee. Last time we saw repaired units come back with old bootloader causing perf jitter. We need sha256, 3 photos (front, serial, label), and smoke logs attached before acceptance.

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Understood. We'll capture sha256, 3 photos, and full smoke logs with timestamps. Perf spot-check can be done either at depot (if you provide container with test harness) or by your infra team post-arrival; recommend depot run basic perf alpha test to save cycles. Fallback air-expedite cost cap if repair fails: $1,600/unit for next-day. Customs note: BCN route may have 24-72h hold in some ports.

Alex P.: Ok. @RMA-bot create playbook: conditional_repair=true, acceptance_window_hours=3, fail_threshold_pct=1.5, required_artifacts=[sha256,3photos,smokelog]. Add procurement contact and customs-team.

RMA-bot: Ticket #RMA-8437 created. Playbook attached: conditional_repair=true; acceptance_window_hours=3; fail_threshold_pct=1.5; artifacts=sha256,3photos,smokelog; notify=procurement,ops-deck,customs-team. :white_check_mark:

Carter (ops): I'll reserve AMS inbound dock for 2026-04-03 morning window and prep reflash container. Need Atlas manifest columns: unit_serial, pre_ship_fw, intended_depot, carrier_awb, photos_link. Also flag if any units have been factory-updated to FW>1.4.0.

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Will send CSV 24h pre-ship with requested columns and carrier AWB. ETA for 25 (if amendment signed today): ship 2026-04-02, arrive AMS 2026-04-03. Remaining 35 target 2026-04-20. Amendment to be emailed tonight.

Maya R.: Ensure SLA includes clause: any unit failing our post-reflash perf spot-check qualifies for replacement + full credit if >1.5% failure rate. Also require firmware provenance note (factory vs depot flash).

Alex P.: I'll sign the amendment with the 1.25% per-unit conditional-repair rebate and the reflash + perf clauses. Will cc legal on the firmware provenance language. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Carter (ops): On it  prepping flash image and test harness. Will confirm dock reservation once AWB arrives.

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Amendment emailed. Manifest will follow 24h before ship. Closing loop.
